title: Built a system that composes vibe coded game assets - Mech Game demo
author: Fulgren09
selftext:
[Mojulo.ai](http://Mojulo.ai) is an MCP and app your local agent drives to create 3D assets as objects and levels, and lets you compose them into games.

It is not a game engine. At the core, it is a 3D spatial grid that outputs deterministic geometry. The stuff you make here can go to Godot, Unity, or even a 3D printer. 

I built this as a ramp for those who are new to development but are native to AI. If you are already experienced in game dev, this isn't going to replace your workflow, but instead offer to automate some of the tedious bits like greyboxing and boilerplate prototyping. 

[Link to repo](https://github.com/zombico/mojulo)

[Play the Mech game](https://zombico.github.io/mobile-suit-arena/game.html)

Free, keyless, no telemetry, you keep everything you make. Hard requirements: must have desktop agent + subscription (or local equivalent), Node 22+, verified on Windows and Mac.

Heads up, install is big because of local embedding model for semantic search (so your agent doesn't have to read everything all the time) + chromium.
